title: Security Risks in AI-Generated Code
description: Understand the most common vulnerabilities introduced by AI and how to prevent them.

data.text: AI models are trained on large amounts of open-source code, which often contains vulnerabilities. Consequently, they may suggest code that is functionally correct but insecure, such as SQL injections or unvalidated inputs.

data.title: Never Skip Code Review
data.text: Always treat AI-generated code as if it was written by a junior developer. Rigorous code review is essential before shipping.
